table.name: people
table.purpose: Registry of individuals (volleyball players, judging by the Russian/Bulgarian names and tall heights), each identified by People_ID and referenced one-to-one by poker_player.

Birth_Date.name: Birth_Date
Birth_Date.description: Person's date of birth, stored as formatted text (e.g. 'April 17, 1987').

Height.name: Height
Height.description: Person's height in centimeters (range 182-207, consistent with athletes).

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.description: Person's country of nationality (Russia or Bulgaria in this data).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Primary key identifying each person; referenced one-to-one by poker_player.People_ID.

table.name: poker_player
table.purpose: Poker career statistics for individual people; one row per poker player, linked to a person in the people table via People_ID. Records earnings, money rank, final tables made, and best tournament finish.

Best_Finish.name: best tournament finishing position
Best_Finish.description: The player's best finishing position in a tournament (1 = first place/win, 2 = runner-up, 3 = third). Small integers 1-3.

Earnings.name: total tournament earnings
Earnings.description: Player's total poker tournament prize money, in dollars (values ~100k-600k).

Final_Table_Made.name: final tables made
Final_Table_Made.description: Count of tournament final tables the player has reached (10-42).

Money_Rank.name: all-time money list rank
Money_Rank.description: Player's rank on the all-time money list (58-166); lower is better. Consistent with Earnings (higher earnings correspond to lower rank number).

People_ID.name: person reference
People_ID.description: Foreign key to people.People_ID, one-to-one; identifies the person who is this poker player.

Poker_Player_ID.name: poker player ID
Poker_Player_ID.description: Primary key of the table; unique identifier for each poker player row.
